info.text:
Americans spent $82.5 billion online before Thanksgiving even started.
Nov 1-22 online spending: up 9.1% vs last year (Adobe Analytics), ahead of Adobe's 6.7% full-season forecast.
Buy now, pay later covered $6.1 billion of it so far.
Adobe forecasts $6.9B today, $12.9B on Black Friday and $15.1B on Cyber Monday.
Sources: Adobe Analytics via Digital Commerce 360 and Chain Store Age (Nov 25, 2026); AP (Nov 26, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
